_about: A clinic in Mexico, in Spanish: labels in the language of the note, the towns it serves, and a policy
of its own that keeps what its analysis is made of. Copy it, change the words, pass it with --lineage.
Start instead from the file this library ships with: silueta lineage > mine.json.
_pools: The names an invented person is drawn from. Every one has to read as either gender, because picking
by gender means inferring the gender of a real person from their name. Digits are refused here.
A company pool is optional and is yours alone: an invented company is very likely a real one.
_values: What identifies in every record this clinic redacts: the towns it serves. A town named alone —
"llamó desde Nogales" — is invisible to the rules, because only a state after it makes it a place.
A town whose name is also a word is removed wherever that word appears; that trade is the author's.
_policies: Safe Harbor runs when no policy is asked for, whatever is written here. A policy is a set of
departures from it, and every one of them is listed in the manifest and in the caveat of every report.
Under HIPAA a policy that keeps what Safe Harbor removes needs an expert determination.
_patterns: Rules of this clinic's own. Declaring any of these REPLACES the pack this library ships with, so a
lineage that brings one rule has to bring the ones it still wants. A rule may name a word list —
{{month-es}}, {{vialidad-mx}} — instead of spelling it out; run silueta lists to see them.
